docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Gītā in the English prose of Annie Besant (1847–1933), the fourth edition of 1922, discourse by discourse: the dialogue of Kṛṣṇa and Arjuna on the field of Kurukṣetra on duty, devotion and knowledge.

From Wikisource · Public domain

The Bhagavad-Gita, translated by Annie Besant (1847–1933), fourth edition (1922), as proofread on English Wikisource by its contributors; the Sanskrit original is ancient. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
